name: Chimney Nation
notes: Both photos are legible menu boards for the same Hungarian chimney-cake shop (a mall-entrance banner and a storefront window decal). Merged the overlapping Sweet/Savory Chimney items; the two signs price them slightly differently ($6.00/$5.50 vs $5.50/$5.50) so the banner's prices were kept for those two. Cone, sandwich and drink items only appear on the window decal.
